name: CSU San Marcos Cubing Open 2026

venue.name: [California State University San Marcos](https://www.csusm.edu/usu/)
venue.address: 595 Campus View Dr, San Marcos, CA 92069

information: ## This competition has Dual Rounds for 3x3! Every competitor will advance to 3x3 Round 2! Newcomers recommended! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
